doc.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Current listening
summary: He likes young drummers and listens to all music but jazz first.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Who do you listen to these days? Who do you like?

You know I like a lot of the young guys that are playing. A lot of the young drummers are really good drummers out there. Carl Allen I love Carl the way he plays; I love Gregory Hutchinson; Herlin Riley; all those guys, they play so good. You know and all the guys that they play with, I try to keep up with all that, and listen to it. But I listen to all the good guys.
What about styles of music, is there anything happening now that you react to one way or the other? © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -12-

Not really, I don’t think so. I still love jazz first. But I listen to and try to keep up with all kinds of music because I have to play all kinds of music in different situations a lot of times. So I try to keep on top of all that you know. But if I sit down or go into a store to buy some music, I’m going to the jazz section first. That’s my love.
